title: ClearPath Goodwill Added to Network and Server Deposit Credits
content:
A goodwill amount is added back to a deposit credit, the Hardware Procurement deposit credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, by the client's ClearPath tier: **100.00 USD** for an active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **50.00 USD** for an active agreement on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and nothing for any other client.

| Client's ClearPath position | Goodwill added back |
|---|---|
| Active, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 100.00 |
| Active, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | 50.00 |
| Active, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | nothing |
| Agreement in any other status, or no agreement | nothing |

The tier and status are read from the client's ClearPath agreement record.
